chute.wall_note: Thinnest remaining wall between the chamfer and each M3 screw-head channel (dia. 5.5). The channel's existing side wall at X+/-15 is 0.5 mm and is unchanged.

frame_source.note: Nominal frame, panels and door from 01_Voron24_350_Frame_and_Enclosure as world bounding boxes (conservative for the extrusion profiles). No Z drives, bed supports or bed wiring are modeled.

parked_fan_intake_review.qualification: Geometric space gauges for the generic fan reference, not CFD or a certified airflow gap. Neighbor tools partially obstruct the intake corridor. Confirm selected fan orientation, hot-soak cooling and actual wire exits with all parked fans powered.

inherited_not_counted: Dock jaw snap detents overlap the dock body by design (flexible retention, dock-internal).
Four MGN9H bearing references overlap their own Y rails in the source gantry model; the X-gantry sweep checks those blocks against everything except the rails.
The Bambu hotend is the synthetic reference (tip Z-78.131); its pad and wiper follow that tip.
limitations: Rigid CAD and sampled straight-line paths (0.5 mm in Y, 1 mm in X), not continuous motion, jaw flexure, thermal growth or machine tolerances.
The Cartographer is checked as an alternative to the Beacon on the same mount; both are not fitted at once.
The bed, frame and gantry are the session snapshots; Z drives, bed supports and wiring are not modelled.
Klipper limits, fan power for parked tools and the cam/servo sequence are outside this geometric audit.
